description: This file defines an enum 'PortfolioProductType' representing different types of portfolio products such as LOAN, SAVING, CLIENT, PROVISIONING, and SHARES within the Fineract project. It includes methods to retrieve type details, convert from integers, and check product types.

classes.name: PortfolioProductType
classes.description: An enum representing different portfolio product types with associated integer codes and string identifiers, along with utility methods.

methods.name: getCode

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static method to map an integer to the corresponding PortfolioProductType enum.
